description: This file defines classes for streaming iterators that process responses from an API, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, including a mock iterator for testing purposes.

classes.name: BaseResponsesAPIStreamingIterator
classes.description: Base class providing shared logic for streaming response iterators, handling chunk processing and response management.

classes.name: ResponsesAPIStreamingIterator
classes.description: Asynchronous iterator class for streaming responses, supporting async iteration and logging.

classes.name: SyncResponsesAPIStreamingIterator
classes.description: Synchronous iterator class for streaming responses, supporting standard iteration and logging.

classes.name: MockResponsesAPIStreamingIterator
classes.description: Mock iterator simulating streaming responses by slicing full response text into chunks for testing purposes.

methods.name: _process_chunk
methods.description: Processes a single data chunk from the stream, parsing JSON and handling response completion.

methods.name: _handle_logging_completed_response
methods.description: Handles logging of completed responses, implemented differently for sync and async classes.

methods.name: __anext__
methods.description: Asynchronous method to get the next response chunk in async iterator.

methods.name: __next__
methods.description: Synchronous method to get the next response chunk in sync iterator.

methods.name: _collect_text
methods.description: Collects and concatenates text content from a ResponsesAPIResponse object in the mock iterator.
